a: What causes retaining-wall deterioration on urban slopes like Samara's, and how should restoration design address overall slope stability?

t: Inicia Escobedo reparación de socavón
te: Escobedo begins repair of sinkhole
a: What investigation and grouting methods are used to repair urban sinkholes like the one in Escobedo?

t: Centro atiende socavón en Casa Blanca
te: Center attends sinkhole in Casa Blanca
a: What subsurface causes are likely behind the Casa Blanca sinkhole, and how should emergency response proceed?

t: Se origina socavón en la parte superior del paso a desnivel en Francisco I. Madero
te: Sinkhole forms at top of underpass in Francisco I. Madero
a: What ground movements and drainage failures beneath an underpass cause sinkholes at its top surface?

t: Rescatan ambulancia que quedó colgada en un socavón en Aucapán
te: Ambulance left hanging in a sinkhole in Aucapán rescued
a: How do soil loss and void formation under a road lead to vehicles hanging over sinkholes, and what rescue precautions apply?
st: Aucapán road sinkhole traps ambulance, Argentina (Oct 2026)

t: رئيس اللجنة الشعبية لمقاطعة جيا لاي يتحدث عن اقتراح تسوية جبل موت.
te: Gia Lai province People's Committee chairman discusses proposal to level Mot Mountain.
a: What are the geotechnical feasibility issues of levelling a hill, including rock quality, slope excavation and stability, compared with preservation?

t: Quais são as opções para o Monte Mot em Quy Nhon: nivelá-lo ou preservar o sítio histórico?
te: What are the options for Mot Mountain in Quy Nhon: level it or preserve the historic site?
a: What geotechnical assessments would be needed to compare levelling Mot Mountain with conserving its historic site, including rock stability and foundation implications?

t: Cerraron un sector de la costanera de una ciudad correntina por hundimiento
a: What causes subsidence along a riverfront promenade in Corrientes, and how should ground investigation guide repair of the costanera?

t: Inician rehabilitación tras hundimiento de losa en el Malecón Costero de Coatzacoalcos
a: What causes slab sinking on a coastal promenade exposed to waves, and what foundation and drainage remedies are appropriate?

t: Particle-scale insights into sand deformation during open-ended pile installation using DIC and X-ray CT
a: Particle-scale imaging of sand around open-ended piles clarifies plugging and displacement mechanisms, offering evidence to refine installation and capacity design assumptions for pile engineers.
au: Fridman DG, Stamati O et al.

t: Shaking table test of high-speed railway bridges with novel variable friction pendulum bearings
a: Shaking table results for novel variable friction pendulum bearings on high-speed rail bridges give engineers tested seismic isolation performance data relevant to specifying bearings and foundation-structure interaction in earthquake regions.
au: Xia X, Yang Z, Huang Y

t: Secondary Compression of Deep Foundations in Carbonate Soils: An InSAR Study of Sunny Isles, Florida
s: Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering
a: Six years of InSAR data show building-specific settlements in carbonate soils that continue after construction, so engineers should plan for long-term deformation and monitoring of deep foundations.
au: Bardet JP

t: Probabilistic State Parameter–Based Liquefaction Triggering Model
s: Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering
a: A lab-anchored, state-parameter liquefaction triggering model offers an alternative to case-history procedures that can be biased, and it is validated against CPTu data practitioners already use.
au: Reyes P, Montalva G et al.

t: Experimental investigation on deformation behavior of pile-supported embankments with geogrid-tire cells reinforcement
a: Experimental results on pile-supported embankments with geogrid-tire cells give practical guidance on deformation behaviour and load transfer for low-cost reinforced embankment design.
au: Zhang H, Jia Y et al.

t: From rockfall to landslide: early warning based on video monitoring in open-pit mines
a: Video monitoring workflows that link rockfall events to developing landslides give open-pit mine operators a practical early-warning approach they could deploy now.
au: Liu F, Deng W et al.

t: Stiffness compatibility in geosynthetic-reinforced column-supported embankment widening over soft ground: numerical insights and a design framework
a: A stiffness-compatibility design framework for geosynthetic-reinforced column-supported embankment widening addresses differential settlement issues that practitioners face when widening existing embankments.
au: Pham TA

t: Extended soil-arching analysis for piled embankments with rectangular pile layouts
s: Proceedings of the Institution of Civil Engineers - Geotechnical Engineering
a: Extended soil-arching solutions for rectangular pile layouts, with error quantified against the equivalent-square simplification, give designers a more accurate load-transfer method for piled embankments.
au: He X, Li G et al.

t: Stability analysis of geotextile tube tailings dams under inclined stacking: composite failure mechanism and oblique horizontal slice method
a: A composite failure mechanism and slice method for geotextile tube tailings dams under inclined stacking provide a stability check that practitioners can use for tailings management.
au: Wu Z, Liu X et al.

t: A unified experimental-numerical assessment of Cable, Pile, and Zone solid rockbolt models in FLAC3D: bond-slip, load transfer, and model selection
a: A combined experimental and numerical comparison of FLAC3D rockbolt models helps engineers select the appropriate bolt model and calibrate bond-slip parameters for support design.
au: Chen J, Ma S, Yuan L

t: Development and properties of thixotropic cementitious slurry for ultra-long horizontal directional pre-grouting
a: A thixotropic cementitious slurry for ultra-long horizontal directional pre-grouting offers a practical grout formulation with properties engineers can specify for long drilled crossings.
au: Gong J, Xi F et al.

t: Integrated seismic and electrical imaging with clustering for the hydro-mechanical screening of a high-altitude earthfill dam
a: Integrated seismic and electrical imaging with clustering offers a practical screening approach for assessing hydro-mechanical condition in earthfill dams.
au: Strallo V, Colombero C, Godio A

t: Geophysical site characterization and scenario-based seismic hazard mapping with slope-based topographic amplification factors: case study of the hilltop Trakošćan castle, Croatia
a: A case study combining geophysical characterisation with slope-based topographic amplification factors shows a practical workflow for seismic hazard mapping at hilltop sites.
au: Stanko D, Korbar T, Markušić S

t: Evaluation of cyclic response of local subgrade materials in Thailand conforming to Chinese high-speed rail standard
a: Cyclic testing of Thai subgrade materials against Chinese high-speed rail standards gives engineers local performance data for railway subgrade design.
au: Kaewdee N, Suddeepong A et al.

t: Impact of spatial soil variability on landslide susceptibility using 3D probabilistic slope stability analysis
s: Georisk: Assessment and Management of Risk for Engineered Systems and Geohazards
a: 3D probabilistic slope analysis shows how spatial soil variability changes landslide susceptibility, helping engineers judge when simple deterministic factors of safety are misleading.
au: Oguz EA, Lacasse S

t: Probabilistic stability and progressive failure of pile-supported embankments under borehole-constrained stratigraphic uncertainty
a: Probabilistic progressive-failure analysis shows how borehole-limited stratigraphic uncertainty affects pile-supported embankment stability, supporting reliability-based site investigation decisions.
au: Lv L, Zheng G et al.

t: Large-Scale Flume Investigation of Pore Water Pressure Evolution under Wave–Soil–Structure Interaction
s: Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering
a: Flume tests show how solitary wave impact generates excess pore pressure and seepage gradients around foundations, informing scour and liquefaction checks for coastal structures.
au: Klait A, Mirghafouri S et al.

t: Progressive soil collapse and tunnel-system response in an underground complex under varying excavation configurations
a: Numerical results on progressive soil collapse and tunnel-system response under different excavation sequences help designers of underground complexes assess staging risks.
au: Xiong H, Huang J et al.

t: Defining the chalk–shale boundary in intact rock samples for engineering geology practice
a: A method for defining the chalk–shale boundary in intact samples gives engineering geologists a clearer classification basis for site characterisation.
au: Gilad R, Hatzor YH

t: Influence of Fabric and Drying Shrinkage on Heat Transfer in Unsaturated Soils: Experimental and Microscale Numerical Study
s: Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering
a: Findings on how fabric and drying shrinkage alter thermal conductivity help engineers of energy geostructures better estimate heat transfer in unsaturated soils.
au: Chen K, Liu K et al.

t: Digital technology and AI for climate-resilient underground infrastructure: Current advances and future directions
a: This review of digital and AI tools for climate-resilient underground infrastructure highlights practical technologies and gaps that owners and designers should track.
au: Heo S, Loy-Benitez J et al.

t: A nonlinear elastoplastic subloading surface model for rock under cyclic loading-unloading with application to compressed air energy storage cavern operation
a: A subloading surface model for rock under cyclic loading supports compressed air energy storage cavern design by capturing the behaviour under repeated pressure cycles.
au: Zhang H, Li G et al.
